209
Herren är min herde, som mig städs’ har kär,
0:00 / —
SV EN FR AR

This is a translation of the Swedish lyrics and cannot be sung.

1.

The Lord is my shepherd, who ever has me dear, Dangers well surround me, but He Himself bears me. Tenderly He bears the weak in His shepherd’s bosom, And “the good Shepherd” is His sweet name.

2.

The Lord is my shepherd; with His wounds He now perfectly heals every wounded sheep. He causes Himself to be cared for concerning the least lamb. “Fear not, little flock,” He says.

3.

The Lord is my shepherd; He gave His life, Gave it out for the sheep. Now with staff and rod He comforts and leads, and though I walk Through the dark valley, He is near His sheep.

4.

The Lord is my shepherd, who finally brings me Home to the Father’s house and makes me blessed. However the wolf may roar, he cannot snatch Any of the lambs out of the Shepherd’s bosom.

Text: Anonym, 1916. Musik: Lyndhurst av Frederic W. Blunt, 1871. 11.11.11.11
